title: Process a refund
blurb: Uses the verified tool Synapse fused from the refund workflow. Every data change asks a human first.
question: Process a refund for ticket TKT-9002 (order ORD-5003, order value 35390 INR): the delivery was 4 days late.

systems.name: orders
systems.description: Customers (clinics, pharmacies), their orders, and shipments - carrier, delays and delay reasons, rerouting. Python/FastAPI.

systems.name: inventory
systems.description: Warehouse stock per SKU, low-stock alerts, expiring batches, stock reservations, draft purchase orders. Python/FastAPI.

systems.name: tickets
systems.description: Customer support tickets, comments, ticket status, refunds under the refund policy. Python/FastAPI.

systems.name: roster
systems.description: Staff, account managers per customer, who is on call per region/team, paging staff. Python/FastAPI.

systems.name: tickets_fused
systems.description: Verified one-step workflow tools composed by Synapse Custom mode from tickets's internal functions.

capabilities.description: List every product in the catalogue with price and cold-chain flag.
Get one product by SKU.
List warehouses with city, region and whether they have cold storage.
Available stock (on hand minus reservations) per warehouse and SKU. Filter by warehouse_id and/or sku.
Items whose available stock is below the reorder threshold, with the shortfall.
Available stock of every SKU in one warehouse (e.g. WH-PUNE).
Where a SKU is available: stock per warehouse, so shortages can be covered from another warehouse.
Batches that expire within the given number of days.
Batches that expire within the given number of days (path form).
Reserve stock for a customer order. Required: warehouse_id (WH-PUNE|WH-MUM|WH-BLR), sku, qty (integer), order_id (ORD-*). Fails if not enough is available.
List stock reservations, optionally for one order.
Create a DRAFT purchase order to restock a warehouse (not sent to suppliers). Required: warehouse_id (WH-*), lines (list of {sku, qty}). Optional: note.
List support tickets. Filter by customer_id, order_id and/or status.
All support tickets raised by one customer (e.g. CUS-101), any status.
All support tickets that reference one order (e.g. ORD-5001).
Get one ticket with its comment thread.
Open a new support ticket. Required: customer_id (CUS-*), subject. Optional: priority (low|medium|high|urgent, default medium), order_id (ORD-*).
Add a comment to a ticket (e.g. an update to the customer). Required: ticket_id (path), author (e.g. "support"), text.
Change a ticket's status. Required: ticket_id (path), status (open|pending|resolved|closed).

Issue a refund for a ticket; the refund policy computes the refundable amount. Required: ticket_id (TKT-*), order_id (ORD-*), amount_inr (the FULL order value, number), reason (exactly one of: late_delivery, damaged, wrong_item, cold_chain_breach, other). For late_delivery also pass days_late (integer). Refuses duplicates and amounts above the auto-refund limit.
List refunds already issued, optionally for one ticket.
List all staff with team, region, role and the customer accounts they manage.
Get one staff member by id, e.g. EMP-21.
The account manager responsible for a customer, e.g. CUS-101.
Who is on call today in a region (west, south), for every team.
Page (alert) a staff member about an incident; sends a real notification. Required: staff_id (EMP-*), message. Optional: severity (low|high|critical, default high).
List pages that were sent, with acknowledgement status.
List all customers (clinics and pharmacies) with city and account tier.
Get one customer by id, e.g. CUS-101: name, city, tier, phone.
All orders placed by one customer.
List all orders with status, items, value and the shipment carrying them.
Get one order by id, e.g. ORD-5001.
Place a new order. Required: customer_id (CUS-*), items (list of {sku, qty}).
Cancel an order that has not shipped yet.
List all shipments with carrier, route, status, promised date and delay reason.
Shipments that are currently delayed, with the reason for each delay.
Get one shipment by id, e.g. SHP-1042.
Orders (and therefore customers) carried by one shipment.
Reroute a shipment to be fulfilled from a different warehouse. Required: shipment_id (path), from_warehouse_id (WH-*).

Validate and issue a refund for a given ticket/order based on policy. Returns the refund record on success or an error dict on failure. Verified example call: {"ticket_id": "TKT-9001", "order_id": "ORD-5001", "amount_inr": 60600, "reason": "late_delivery", "days_late": 4}
